text:
mike.s: Heads-up — customer on the POC wants a CAIQ mapping for encryption, key rotation, and audit log ownership. They asked for a single-page matrix they can attach to their vendor-risk team.
anita.r: short answer: Hosted = Redwood manages service keys and rotation; Dedicated = Redwood manages runtime keys but customer can opt for customer-managed KMS for data-at-rest; Private (VPC/on-prem) = customer manages key material (we integrate with KMS/HSM).
jess.k: i can draft the matrix. mike, can you confirm whether we provide syslog/CloudWatch export for Dedicated or if it's only for Private?
mike.s: for Dedicated we ship audit logs to a customer-controlled bucket/endpoint by default (we don't ingest into customer SIEM). For Hosted we retain audit logs in our infra and provide extracts on request under contract. Private = customer controls log storage.
samir: customer asked about proof points for rotation policy (frequency, mechanism). do we have a public doc or statement? security-bot: Attached excerpt from compliance pack: "Key rotation policy: service keys rotated every 90 days; KMS-integrated keys subject to customer rotation schedules; cryptoperiods aligned to NIST SP 800-57." (doc id: sec-pack-v2.1)
anita.r: we should call out the shared responsibility rows explicitly in the CAIQ table: Encryption at rest, Key rotation, Key storage, Access controls, Audit log retention, KMS admin privileges.
mike.s: agreed. i'll add a column: "Default responsibility" and "Optional customer-managed". example row:
  - Encryption at rest: Default = Redwood (Hosted/Dedicated), Optional = Customer-managed KMS (Dedicated/Private)
  - Key rotation: Default = Redwood (Hosted/Dedicated service keys), Optional = Customer schedule when using customer-managed keys
  - Audit logs: Default = Redwood retention (Hosted), Customer-export (Dedicated/Private)
jess.k: i'll convert that into a one-pager and include exact CAIQ control IDs (e.g., CC-1, SEF-2) where applicable. any objections to me sharing the draft directly with the customer's vendor-risk email list? :thumbsup:
samir: go for it. include this snippet for escalation: "If vendor-risk requires turnkey key management, Private deployment with customer KMS/HSM is recommended."
mike.s: also ping infra to confirm log export endpoints for the Dedicated cluster we'll provision in the POC.
security-bot: Deploy checklist created: POC-179123 — confirm KMS integration, export endpoints, and rotation SLA. Assigned to @anita.r and @infra-oncall.
anita.r: noted. i'll attach the CAIQ matrix draft by EOD and drop in the shared drive link.
jess.k: thanks — i'll send to customer and cc sales-engineering. will update thread with any followups. :white_check_mark:
